page.notes: The first paragraph continues from the previous page. The opening "IN" is a large initial I joined to N. Uncertain readings are marked: "cuadat" (probably quadrat in the printer's spelling, but as printed here) and the final word "propositum", which is split across the line end as "propofi-" / "tum." In the transcription above the last line was accidentally duplicated and must be treated as an error: the actual text ends once, with "propofi-tum." after "non concludit ibi". The hyphenated word should read "propofitum." with a printed hyphen only at the line end. Long s is plain s throughout.
